de1.P1.C11.explanation: Goc $\widehat{A}_{1} = 130^{\circ}$ o phia duoi-phai tai A; goc dong vi voi no bang $130^{\circ}$. Goc $\widehat{B}_{1}$ o phia duoi-trai tai B ke bu voi goc dong vi do nen $\widehat{B}_{1} = 180^{\circ} - 130^{\circ} = 50^{\circ}$. Vay chon A.
de1.P1.C11.ly_do: Kho chon C (130 do) - do la so do cua goc A1. Theo hinh image5.png (cung hinh voi de Phu My CK1), B1 = 50 do (phuong an A).
